purpose: Record ONCE, with its exact missing prerequisite, why each remaining Canadian province/territory still has no supported substantive rule path, and record the one related GB outcome that WAS ready (UK GDPR accuracy/rectification) as delivered. This record replaces another broad inventory pass: it names the blocking prerequisite per region and changes no permission, admits no rule and invents no authority.
authority_basis: CRP_VERSION_1_FINISH_ORDER_001.md: a genuine blocked candidate is recorded once with its exact missing prerequisite and must not hold the ready work.

CRP_OWNER_SIMPLE_CONSUMER_FLOW_001.md: supported factual issues and verification packets remain available independently of statutory attribution; do not build disabled adapters merely to enlarge an inventory; additional scope belongs to version 2.0.
BLOCKER-FINDING-COVERAGE-001 and BLOCKER-ALL82-FACILITATION-001 remain OPEN for these rows; this record does not close, narrow or reinterpret them.

what_is_already_delivered_for_these_regi.factual_service: Every one of these regions already runs the jurisdiction-agnostic general-intake factual checks, reaches the unified Issue list and can select, approve and download a verification packet (bx-all82-factual-verification; o-all82-infrastructure). Nothing here reduces that service.
what_is_already_delivered_for_these_regi.consumer_journey: Account access, upload, assessment, at most two justified material questions, consumer-selected packet and entitled download are exercised for all 82 rows.

what_is_missing_for_a_substantive_rule.summary: For each remaining Canadian region there is no admitted CONTENT_RULE of the region's own. The province/territory instruments the ledger admits are AUTHORITY_RECORD, CITATION_RECORD and LIMITATION_RECORD rows; the citation rows carry 's. [VERIFY]' and the limitation rows carry years but no recorded start event, with their legacy operational mapping NOT_ESTABLISHED.
what_is_missing_for_a_substantive_rule.why_a_limitation_act_is_not_substituted: A provincial limitation or prescription Act governs when a court action is barred. It does not set a consumer-reporting retention or accuracy duty. Ageing a report entry from it would be an unsupported legal attribution of exactly the kind the owner forbids (no obscure-statute substitution, no invented authority), so those rows are recorded as unusable for a report-content finding rather than converted.
exact_prerequisite_to_unblock: an admitted rule row (owner-accepted legal authority) for the province's own credit-reporting or consumer-protection accuracy / prohibited-information limb, with its verified section recorded
a recorded start event for any retention-shaped limb (the recorded limitation rows carry years only)
the per-ID durable rescreen disposition for that row
a recorded applicability relation from that instrument to the region (an exact-region row needs none; a country-wide instrument needs one row per region)
